build_ai2arc_dataset: build the ai2_arc dataset using tfds.builder_cls('ai2_arc') with ARC-Challenge or ARC-Easy config
create_ai2arc_builder: create an Ai2Arc Builder instance with tfds.builder_cls('ai2_arc') for downloading and preparing the dataset
test_ai2arc_features: test the ai2_arc dataset features including id, question, choices, and answerKey fields
summarize_ai2arc_splits: summarize the ai2_arc dataset splits: TRAIN, VALIDATION, and TEST from ARC-Challenge or ARC-Easy
review_ai2arc_config: review the Ai2ArcConfig builder config with ARC-Challenge and ARC-Easy dataset variants
